item.tfmg.factory_inspector.hint.block: Right-click a machine: what works, what stops it, what to do
item.tfmg.factory_inspector.hint.air: Right-click the air: your progress and the next step
tfmg.inspector.nothing: Nothing to inspect on this block: it has no settings, tanks or power.
tfmg.inspector.not_tfmg: The Factory Inspector only reads The Factory Must Grow machines.
tfmg.inspector.all_good: No problem found: everything this machine needs is in place.
tfmg.inspector.readings_only: No specific check for this block; the readings above are all there is.
tfmg.inspector.kinetic.no_rotation.fix: Connect a shaft or cogwheel from a rotation source to it.
tfmg.inspector.kinetic.overstressed.fix: Add stress capacity (more or bigger sources) or slow the machines down.
tfmg.inspector.electric.generating: Generating up to %s V and %s W
tfmg.inspector.electric.no_voltage.fix: Connect it to a generator through cables, on a face that accepts power (handbook: Electricity Basics).
tfmg.inspector.electric.not_enough_power: The network lacks power: %s W generated, %s W needed
Add generators or remove consumers; the whole network stops until generation covers usage.
tfmg.inspector.electric.overvoltage: Over its voltage limit: %s V for %s V max. It will break and drop nothing!
tfmg.inspector.electric.overvoltage.fix: Lower the voltage with a transformer, or use parts rated for it.
tfmg.inspector.electric.near_overvoltage: Close to its voltage limit: %s V of %s V max
tfmg.inspector.electric.near_overcurrent: Close to its current limit: %s A of %s A max
tfmg.inspector.electric.overcurrent.fix: Use a higher rated cable hub or split the load over several lines.
tfmg.inspector.progress.complete: Every step of the production chain is done. The factory has grown!
tfmg.inspector.progress.footer: A step counts once you have crafted, picked up or placed the item.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.coal_coke.how: Place a Coke Oven (a single one works; a square of N x N ovens built up and backwards from the bottom front block cokes faster from 3x3) and feed it coal. Pump CO2 out of its top face. Handbook: Coke Oven.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.fireproof_brick: Dig fireclay (in striated rock layers), craft fireclay balls into fireclay and smelt it. Handbook: First Materials.
Crush coal coke with Create's crushing wheels or millstone. It is the only blast furnace fuel.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.limesand.how: Crush limestone. The blast furnace needs it as flux for steel.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.blast_stove.how: Craft blast stoves and build one (up to 2x2 wide). Feed it air from air intakes and furnace gas or creosote. Handbook: Hot Air.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.blast_furnace.h: Craft a Blast Furnace Output and build the 3x3 tower around it, at least 3 layers high. Handbook: Blast Furnace.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.steel_ingot.how: Pump molten steel from the blast furnace into a casting basin: 144 mB casts one ingot. Handbook: Casting and Steel.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.heavy_plate.how: Make heavy plates from steel (see JEI). Most steel machines need them.
Crush bauxite into powder, then mix 4 powder and 1 coal coke dust in a superheated basin for your first ingots. Handbook: Aluminium.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.steel_mechanism: Sequenced assembly on a heavy plate: steel ingot, aluminium ingot, screw, screwdriver (see JEI).
tfmg.inspector.milestone.magnet.how: Make magnetic alloy, then craft your first magnet by hand: redstone blocks around the ingot and a compass below. Handbook: Winding and Magnets.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.generator.how: Sequenced assembly on a shaft (capacitor, steel plate, copper spool, magnet, steel mechanism, screwdriver). Spin it above 40 RPM. Handbook: Power.
Sequenced assembly on a shaft (see JEI). Power it from its back face. Handbook: Electric Machines.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.chemical_vat.ho: Build a steel vat with machines on top and heat below for plastics, acid and electrolysis. Handbook: Chemical Vats.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.surface_scanner: Place it on a Machine Input turning at 64 RPM or more to find oil deposits. Handbook: Finding Oil.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.pumpjack.how: Build a pumpjack above a deposit with industrial pipes all the way down to it. Handbook: Pumpjack.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.distillation.ho: Controller on the side of a steel tank, outputs stacked above it, heat underneath. Handbook: Distillation.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.engine.how: Place a regular engine, add its components block by block, fuel it and give it a redstone signal. Handbook: Engines.
tfmg.inspector.milestone.plastic.how: Turn ethylene or propylene from distillation into plastic in a heated vat with a mixer. Handbook: Chemical Vats.
